properties.name: FEEDBACK_STORAGE_CONFIG
properties.description: JSON config for feedback storage. Example local: {"type":"local","local":{"path":"/home/appuser/feedback/feedback.ndjson"}}. Example dynamo: {"type":"dynamo","dynamo":{"table_name":"aggregator_feedback","aws_region":"eu-central-1"}}.

properties.name: feedback.admin.username
properties.description: Admin username for feedback admin endpoint HTTP Basic authentication.

properties.name: feedback.admin.password
properties.description: Admin password for feedback admin endpoint HTTP Basic authentication.

properties.name: catalog.base-url
properties.description: Base URL of catalog service API, for example http://catalog:8080.
